Its own arithmetic reproduces exactly - 34 cm x 44 cm x 2.6 cm = 3890 cc, i.e. 3.89 L, and 50/3.89 = 12.9, which the document reports as 13 - and verbatim it continues 'the turn down ratio ... with a traditional impeller is 13 (50 L/3.89 L), whereas the turn down ratio using an impeller according to an embodiment of the invention is in the range of about 25 (50 L/2 L) to about 36 (50 L/1.4 L).' THREE DEFECTS CARRIED WITH IT RATHER THAN HIDDEN. Both ends of its 25-36 span come from the SAME example in the same document, so that span is not two independent endpoints. And its own MEASURED traditional unagitated volume is 'about 4 L', which gives 12.5 rather than the 13 its CALCULATION reports - so one end of the comparison is calculated and the other measured. Its claims separately recite only 'a turndown ratio of at least about 20 ... at least about 25, or at least about 30', which is claim language and not a measurement.
